title: Snail wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- snail body / foot -->
  <path d="M10,78 Q8,68 20,66 L78,66 Q92,66 92,76 Q92,84 80,84 L20,84 Q10,84 10,78 Z" fill="#7ED957"/>
  <!-- foot underside shadow -->
  <path d="M14,80 L88,80 Q84,84 80,84 L20,84 Q14,84 14,80 Z" fill="#5BB83F"/>
  <!-- shell -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="26" fill="#FF8C42"/>
  <!-- shell spiral -->
  <path d="M58,50 m0,-18 a18,18 0 1,1 -0.1,0 M58,50 m0,-12 a12,12 0 1,0 0.1,0 M58,50 m0,-6 a6,6 0 1,1 -0.1,0" fill="none" stroke="#FFD166" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- shell center glow -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="50" r="4" fill="#FFE8A3"/>
  <!-- head / neck -->
  <path d="M14,68 Q10,54 22,50 Q30,48 32,60 L32,68 Z" fill="#A8E86B"/>
  <!-- antenna -->
  <path d="M22,50 Q20,42 16,38" fill="none" stroke="#A8E86B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="15" cy="36" r="3" fill="#FF6FA8"/>
  <path d="M26,49 Q27,41 31,37" fill="none" stroke="#A8E86B" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="32" cy="35" r="3" fill="#FF6FA8"/>
  <!-- sunglasses -->
  <rect x="12" y="56" width="12" height="9" rx="3" fill="#3A2E6E"/>
  <rect x="25" y="56" width="11" height="9" rx="3" fill="#3A2E6E"/>
  <rect x="23" y="59" width="3" height="2" fill="#3A2E6E"/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x="14" y="58" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#8FD3FF"/>
  <rect x="27" y="58" width="4" height="2" rx="1" fill="#8FD3FF"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M18,70 Q23,74 28,70" fill="none" stroke="#4A9B2E" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- shell highlight -->
  <path d="M42,32 Q50,26 60,28" fill="none" stroke="#FFC08A" stroke-width="4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
